query: SELECT DISTINCT cmt.receivable_id as old_id, cmt.ticked, cmt.ticked_by, cmt.step FROM collection_manual_ticks cmt LEFT JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = cmt.receivable_id WHERE ar.id IS NULL AND cmt.receivable_id BETWEEN 3768000 AND 3769000 ORDER BY cmt.receivable_id LIMIT 20;
